narr: Monsoon moisture surged back across northern Arizona which allowed strong to severe thunderstorms to form.
ev: Prescott Valley Police reported hazardous flooding at the intersection of East Lakeshore Drive and East Towago Drive and the intersection of Navajo Drive and Florentine Road. Rain Gauges in the area recorded from 1.50 and 1.86 inches of rain.
lsr: PRESCOTT VALLEY POLICE DEPT REPORTED HAZARDOUS FLOODING AT THE INTERSECTION OF E LAKESHORE DR AND E TOWAGO DR. PUBLIC RAIN GAUGE REPORTS OF 1.50 TO 1.86 INCHES OF RAIN WITHIN THE AREA.
REPORT OF THE INTERSECTION OF FLORENTINE RD AND NAVAJO DR FLOODED AND IMPASSABLE.
